Pediatric Dentistry at Clearwater, FL

BOOK NOW

Pediatric Dentistry For Kids Of All Ages

Children of all ages should have access to the best dentist possible and receive regular dental visits in order to promote proper dental development and behavior. We suggest scheduling their first dental visit around their first birthday or when their teeth begin erupting. Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya has extensive experience working with children of various ages and provides exceptional care to foster appropriate oral development and behavioral changes.


 Early dental visits provide us with an opportunity to build trust between your child and our team as well as familiarize them with the dental environment. At initial pediatric dentistry appointments in Clearwater, FL we focus on educating both you and your child on proper oral hygiene practices as well as the benefits of pediatric dentistry. Our practice offers Myobrace(r) therapy as well as behavioral therapy services designed specifically to aid child development.

 

With our friendly and gentle care approach, we aim to make every visit a positive and enjoyable experience for both parent and child. By prioritizing early dental care and guidance for your child's dental wellbeing and future success, we can ensure they have excellent dental health for years to come.

  • Myobrace orthodontics

Guiding Healthy Habits Early On

Our pediatric dentistry approach offers an all-natural and healthier method for straightening teeth and improving overall oral health in children.


When children use pacifiers or thumb sucking regularly, their habitual use exerts pressure that alters jaw bone positions and leads to narrow or improper alignment of their jaw bone, potentially altering how the child chews his food or even leads them down pacifier-sucking routes.

 
Through our combined approach of Myobrace therapy and behavioral interventions, we work closely with your children to inculcate proper breathing and eating habits as well as reposition their jaw for optimal development according to their genetic potential and ensuring they have healthy smiles for life.


By providing early intervention services, we ensure your child receives essential dental care and developmental guidance needed for a smooth start to life. Our aim is to facilitate healthy habits early on while encouraging proper growth and development to ensure years of confident smiles later on.
